summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 136,101 Class I shares for $1,316,100 to feeder vehicles, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S, and declared monthly distributions of $0.074775 per share for three classes. The BDC also disclosed continuous public offerings totaling up to $10B with cumulative proceeds. These are routine operational and capital-raising disclosures for a business development company, not a special situation. No strategic event, change of control, or extraordinary corporate action is present. Watch for continued monthly NAV-based share issuance and distribution sustainability, but no event-driven angle.
